assertions.reason: The thermostat stays in the bank's heat mode until the period starts.
Nothing is written between the 15:30 cycle (which re-asserted the bank) and the period's start.

At the high-cost period's start (16:15) the bank ends and the comfort band is written once (heat 68 F, the furnace stops (indoor 75.5 F is far above 68 F)); before #1405 this write waited for the 16:30 cycle.

No mode change at 16:15: the heat bank just ran, so the comfort-edge settling guard keeps heat and the band write is heat 68 F, where the furnace stops (indoor 75.5 F is far above 68 F). This is what real Home Assistant does (its thermostat reports hvac_action); the setpoint (68) differs from the bank target (76), so a bank re-send is told apart by the value.
No re-send between the bank end and the next cycle.
The regular cycle re-asserts the band as it always does.
No mode change at the 16:30 cycle either: it re-asserts heat 68 F in the mode the bank ran (before #1405 this cycle made the first band write).
After the bank no surface claims one (issue #1404).
After the bank the briefing quotes the band write actually made at the period start.

name: tou_home_heat_bank_ends_on_time_1405
description: Issue #1405: a home pre-heated to 76 F for a 16:15 high-cost period. At the period's start the bank ends; before the fix the thermostat kept the bank setpoint until the next 30-minute cycle (here 16:30) wrote the comfort band. Now the Home/Guest bank-end timer (the mirror of the Away/Vacation T_start timer) makes that band write at 16:15: heat 68 F (the settling guard keeps the mode the bank just ran), so the furnace stops (indoor 75.5 F is far above 68 F). The thermostat reports hvac_action, as on real Home Assistant (the Tier B run of this golden agrees).

verdict.summary: A home bank ends at the high-cost period's start, not up to 30 minutes later
verdict.observed_behavior: The band write (heat 68 F) lands at 16:15; before the fix the first band write after the bank was the 16:30 cycle's.
verdict.expected_behavior: Occupant view: during the expensive period the thermostat holds the comfort band, not the pre-conditioning setpoint.
verdict.effectiveness: Fails on 6ebdb16 (no write at 16:15, the band lands at 16:30). Deleting the home bank-end timer fails the 16:15 row; a timer that re-sends the bank (heat 76 F) fails it too (the band value is 68).
verdict.alignment: docs/scheduler-spec.md and docs/08-COMPUTATION-REFERENCE.md (Issue #1405) describe the Home/Guest bank-end timer.
verdict.user_outcome: If this regressed, a pre-cooled home would keep cooling to the floor (or a pre-heated one heating to the ceiling) for up to 30 minutes into the expensive period.
